observations: Photo 0 shows a physical game case for 'Assassin's Creed Odyssey' on a PS4 console.
The case is blue with the PS4 logo at the top.
The cover art features a character in a red tunic holding a sword.
A yellow sticker on the lower left of the case indicates '18' age rating.
The case appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or damage.
The seller's text claims it is a 'disc' and 'test working perfectly'.

claims.claim: Clean Used Assassin Creed Odyssey PS4 disc
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the game case with no visible damage; the disc is not shown, but the case is clean and intact.
No video or photo of the disc being inserted and tested; no proof of functionality.

risks.risk: Disc may be damaged or not functional
risks.proof: Photo of the disc inside the case, or a video showing the disc being inserted and read by the PS4.

risks.risk: Game may be pirated or unauthorized
risks.proof: Photo of the back of the case showing the barcode and serial number, or a screenshot of the game's digital copy.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially pirated, which reduces value

proof_requests: Photo of the disc inside the case.
Photo of the back of the case showing barcode and serial number.
Video of the disc being inserted and tested on a PS4 console.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
